Built on site · Traditional craftsmanship

Superior Standard Features

A distinctive 9/12 roofline paired with proven framing and weather-resistant exterior construction.

Foundation & Floor

4×6 pressure-treated beams over 16×16×4-inch solid concrete support pads; 2×6 pressure-treated floor joists at 16 inches on center, finished with ¾-inch pressure-treated exterior-rated plywood decking.

Framing & Roof

2×4 kiln-dried wall studs at 16 inches on center, engineered 2×4 trusses at 24 inches on center, and a 9/12 traditional gable-roof profile.

Doors & Windows

Site-built 60×80-inch Craftsman wood double doors with black hardware, keyed lock, and inactive-leaf bolts; two 24×30-inch white aluminum single-hung windows with screens and locks.

Exterior Siding

Roseburg DuraTemp included; optional LP SmartSide Vertical Textured Panel, Board & Batten, Lap, or GP Vinyl Lap siding.

Roof & Weather Protection

½-inch CDX plywood roof sheathing, architectural asphalt shingles and synthetic underlayment, with roof ventilation and flashing detailed for the building design.

Built on Site

Constructed on your property using engineered pad layout and anchorage appropriate to site and building conditions. Site preparation beyond the included 6-inch leveling allowance is quoted separately.

Helpful details

Frequently Asked Questions

Is The Grand Depot built on my property?

Yes. Each Grand Depot is built on site, with access, placement, pad layout, and anchoring reviewed as part of your written proposal.

Which exterior siding is included in the listed price?

Roseburg DuraTemp is the standard siding. LP SmartSide Vertical Textured Panel, Board & Batten, Lap, and GP Vinyl Lap are available as priced upgrades.

Does the price include finished interior walls or ceilings?

No. Standard prices cover an exterior weather-tight shell. Interior insulation, wall and ceiling finishes, electrical work, and other improvements are not included unless separately specified.

When must the exterior be painted or stained?

Required exterior caulking and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days after construction. Optional exterior finishing can be quoted separately.

Are additional sizes and site options available?

The full pricing table includes 21 sizes. Site conditions, access, customization and additional preparation are addressed in your written proposal.
